name: PoN PQ network and rollback witness
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - trillionnium/**
      - config/pon/pq-cross-branch-corpus-v1.json
      - config/pon/pq-system-required-tests-v1.json
      - scripts/ci/record_pq_native_command.py
      - scripts/ci/test_record_pq_native_command.py
      - scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py
      - scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py
      - .github/workflows/pon-pq-system-continuation.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native:
    name: PQ network and witness (${{ matrix.runner }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      EXPECTED_TESTED: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prepare exact-source command records
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/pq-system-records"
          mkdir "$out"
          echo "PQ_OUT=$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$RUNNER_TEMP/pq-system-target" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          cat > "$out/run-command.sh" <<'SH'
          set -euo pipefail
          label="$1"
          shift
          source_args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --candidate "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --tested "$EXPECTED_TESTED")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            source_args+=(--base "$EXPECTED_BASE")
          fi
          command_status=0
          python3 scripts/ci/record_pq_native_command.py "${source_args[@]}" --label "$label" --output "$PQ_OUT" -- "$@" || command_status=$?
          if test -f "$PQ_OUT/$label.log"; then
            if test "$command_status" -ne 0; then
              tail -n 200 "$PQ_OUT/$label.log"
            else
              case "$label" in
                node-lib) sed -n '/test result:/p; /trnm-state-delta-walk-observation-v1/p; /trnm-current-account-.*observation-v1/p' "$PQ_OUT/$label.log" ;;
                cost-*) cat "$PQ_OUT/$label.log" ;;
              esac
            fi
          fi
          exit "$command_status"
          SH
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_TESTED")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      - name: Require retained source and claim controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test_file in test_ci_source_integrity.py test_record_pq_native_command.py test_pq_research_integration.py test_pq_chain_claim_guard.py test_pq_authority_surface_scan.py; do
            bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" "${test_file%.py}" python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p "$test_file" -v
          done
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" pq-source python3 scripts/ci/check_pq_research_integration.py
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" pq-hold python3 scripts/ci/pq_chain_claim_guard.py
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" repository python3 scripts/ci/check_repository.py
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" inventory python3 scripts/refresh_distributed_source_inventory.py --check
      - name: Install the original pinned compiler
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Prepare the independently pinned OpenSSL provider
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR="$PQ_OUT"
          bash scripts/ci/prepare_pq_provider.sh
      - name: Record compiler, exact locked graph and formatting
        id: pq_build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" compiler rustc +1.95.0 -Vv
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" locked-graph cargo +1.95.0 metadata --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --format-version 1
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" format cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" build cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --all-features --no-run --message-format=json
      - name: Execute every required native effect and rejection control
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - "$PQ_OUT/required-tests.tsv" <<'PY'
          import json, re, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          value = json.loads(Path('config/pon/pq-system-required-tests-v1.json').read_text())
          assert value['schema'] == 'trnm-pq-system-required-tests-v1'
          assert value['whole_chain_quantum_security_qualified'] is False
          tests = value['tests']
          assert len(tests) == value['expected_meaningful_controls'] and len(set(tests)) == len(tests)
          assert len(tests) == 49
          assert all(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:::[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*', x) for x in tests)
          assert not set(tests) & set(value['child_process_harnesses_not_counted'])
          Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(''.join(f'native-{i:02d}\t{name}\n' for i, name in enumerate(tests)))
          PY
          failed=0
          while IFS=$'\t' read -r label selector; do
            if ! bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" "$label" cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --all-features "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1; then
              failed=1
            elif ! python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$PQ_OUT/$label.log" --test "$selector" > "$PQ_OUT/$label-execution.json"; then
              failed=1
            fi
          done < "$PQ_OUT/required-tests.tsv"
          test "$failed" = 0
      - name: Preserve native control records before the complete regression
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.pq_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: pq-system-controls-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pq-system-records/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve the complete original Node library regression suite
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.pq_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" node-lib cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --all-features -- --show-output --test-threads=1
      - name: Check strict Clippy without rewriting source
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.pq_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" clippy cargo +1.95.0 clippy --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --tests --all-features -- -D warnings
      - name: Observe complete component costs with unchanged native budgets
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.pq_build.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRNM_PQ_AUTH_COST_DIRECTORY="$PQ_OUT/pq-authentication-cost"
          export TRNM_NATIVE_ROOT_DIGEST_COST_OUTPUT="$PQ_OUT/native-root-digest-cost.jsonl"
          failed=0
          for selector in \
            store::history_page::tests::inline_record_tests::history_inline_record_complete_call_cost \
            ingress::public_v3::pq_identity::verifier_cache::tests::pq_caller_authentication_complete_cost \
            account_archive_prototype::native_root_digest::tests::native_root_digest_paired_complete_root_cost_observation; do
            label="cost-${selector##*::}"
            if ! bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" "$label" cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib --all-features "$selector" -- --exact --ignored --show-output --test-threads=1; then
              failed=1
            elif ! python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$PQ_OUT/$label.log" --test "$selector" > "$PQ_OUT/$label-execution.json"; then
              failed=1
            fi
          done
          selector=pon_commitment::unchanged_snapshot_tests::unchanged_snapshot_full_binding_cost
          label="cost-${selector##*::}"
          if ! bash "$PQ_OUT/run-command.sh" "$label" cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-mvcc-fee --lib "$selector" -- --exact --ignored --show-output --test-threads=1; then
            failed=1
          elif ! python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$PQ_OUT/$label.log" --test "$selector" > "$PQ_OUT/$label-execution.json"; then
            failed=1
          fi
          test "$failed" = 0
      - name: Preserve complete records including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: pq-system-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pq-system-records/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Record one command and its exact source; successful exit is not PQ acceptance.

The existing source verifier checks every tracked raw byte before and after the
command. Named libtest executions still require check_required_native_test.py.
Abrupt termination leaves an incomplete receipt, never a synthesized success.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time

from verify_ci_source import ROOT, verify


def run(args, root=ROOT):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,160}", args.label):
        raise ValueError("noncanonical command label")
    if not args.command:
        raise ValueError("missing command")
    if (not args.output.is_absolute()
            or args.output.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve())):
        raise ValueError("command records must be outside source")
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    receipt = args.output / (args.label + ".json")
    log = args.output / (args.label + ".log")
    record = {
        "schema": "trnm-pq-native-command-v1", "status": "running",
        "argv": args.command, "cwd": str(root), "exit_code": None,
        "started_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "log_file": log.name, "log_sha256": None,
        "whole_chain_quantum_security_qualified": False,
        "environment": {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in (
            "CARGO_BUILD_JOBS", "CARGO_INCREMENTAL", "CARGO_TARGET_DIR",
            "RUST_TEST_THREADS", "RUSTFLAGS", "CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS",
            "RUSTC", "RUSTC_WRAPPER", "RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER",
            "OPENSSL_DIR", "OPENSSL_STATIC", "TRNM_PQ_OPENSSL",
            "TRNM_PQ_OPENSSL_SHA256", "TRNM_PQ_OPENSSL_VERSION",
            "GITHUB_RUN_ID", "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "RUNNER_ARCH")},
    }
    with receipt.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream)
    code = 1
    started = time.monotonic_ns()
    try:
        record["before"] = verify(args.kind, args.candidate,
                                  args.base if args.kind == "prospective-merge" else None,
                                  args.tested if args.kind == "prospective-merge" else None,
                                  root)
        if record["before"]["tested_commit"] != args.tested:
            raise ValueError("tested commit differs from requested source")
        with log.open("xb") as stream:
            code = subprocess.run(args.command, cwd=root, stdout=stream,
                                  stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False).returncode
        record["exit_code"] = code
        with log.open("rb") as stream:
            record["log_sha256"] = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
        record["log_bytes"] = log.stat().st_size
        record["after"] = verify(args.kind, args.candidate,
                                 args.base if args.kind == "prospective-merge" else None,
                                 args.tested if args.kind == "prospective-merge" else None,
                                 root)
        if record["before"] != record["after"]:
            raise ValueError("source identity changed during command")
        record["status"] = "command_succeeded" if code == 0 else "command_failed"
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        record.update(status="record_failed", error=str(error))
        code = code or 1
    finally:
        record["elapsed_ns"] = time.monotonic_ns() - started
        receipt.write_text(json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n",
                           encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"status": record["status"], "receipt": str(receipt),
                      "exit_code": record["exit_code"]}, sort_keys=True))
    return code if code >= 0 else 128 - code


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=("head", "prospective-merge"), required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--candidate", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--tested", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--base")
    parser.add_argument("--label", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.command[:1] == ["--"]:
        args.command = args.command[1:]
    return run(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
